BUG 3 FIXED: plan.tsx (149 lines) - programmatic check confirmed NO 'Premium', 'Próximamente', or '🔒' text anywhere. Only FREE_PERKS with ✅ checkmarks. '💚 FuchoMX es y será siempre 100% gratuito.' footer shown.

Quiniela flow: All 9 Liga MX matches render with Gana X / Empate / Gana Y options. Selections use filled red circles. Counter updates ('Faltan N partidos'). After all 9 selections: 'Todos los partidos seleccionados' shown. ENVIAR QUINIELA button activates (bright red, not greyed).

Profile→Plan navigation: 'Tu Plan Gratuito' button found at y=848 on profile screen. Clicking navigates to /profile/plan correctly. Plan screen shows Plan Gratuito badge + 8 free perks - no premium content.
